annotations.title: Store a document as text or as SQLite bytes

description: Writes the document again as `text` (diffs in git) or as `sqlite` bytes, and every later write keeps that shape — the app’s Save as text. Refused when the text would not carry it — a document keeping the ledger, for one. Writes nothing until `commit: true`.

as.description: How the file is stored from now on.

commit.description: Write it. Omit or false for the dry run.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.
